rules: Every dependency edge must include type and evidence.
Distinguish runtime-import, asset-reference, data-contract, boundary-coordination, and governance-documentation edges.
Never infer a runtime dependency from an ownership-boundary statement alone.
Unknown or unverified edges must be labelled unknown rather than guessed.
A file ownership change requires impact review of all known consumers.
Dependency inventory is incomplete until static references and relevant runtime evidence have been assessed.
